title: security(rbac-v2,kms): enforce KMS region pinning + audit hardening
author: Priya Nair
description: Context: customers (enterprise/Dedicated/Private) require stricter enforcement of KMS/data residency constraints and more comprehensive audit trails for RBAC v2 policy decisions. Motivation: previous incident (SUP-9876) showed silent cross-region KMS fallback when a pinned region was unavailable and limited audit detail for policy decisions. This PR enforces KMS region pinning at enforcement time, surfaces policy decision reasons in audit logs, and hardens migrations and tests. Changes: 1) rbac enforcer now validates kms_region residency for create/update/access flows with configurable enforcement modes (audit-only / enforce); 2) audit logger schema extended to include policy_decision_reason, kms_region_requested, kms_region_resolved, and enforcement_mode; 3) DB migration to add kms_region and enforcement_mode to policy records; 4) feature flag and rollout plan for staged enablement; 5) integration and e2e tests covering cross-region fallback and telemetry; 6) docs and example policy samples. Backwards compatibility: default is audit-only for existing tenants; enforcement is behind a feature flag and rollout plan in the PR description. Testing: unit tests, new integration tests, and a staged e2e run in integration CI. Rollout: staged by org; ops playbook included. Linear/Jira: ENG-5122, SEC-121, SUP-9876.
